recommendedTextbook.title: Essential Agricultural Science for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Iwena
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

subtopics: Principles of Mendelian genetics applied to agronomy
Aims of crop and animal improvement (yield, disease resistance, early maturity)
Methods of improvement: Introduction, selection (mass, pedigree), hybridization, genetic engineering
objectives: Apply monohybrid Punnett square crosses to predict grain yield inheritance in maize
Contrast phenotypic mass selection with genotypic progeny testing
Debate ethical and environmental biosafety considerations of GMO crops in Nigeria

topics.topic: Farm Mechanization, Tractor Systems and Agricultural Implements
subtopics: Internal combustion tractor engines: Fuel, cooling, electrical, and transmission systems
Primary and secondary tillage implements: Disc plough, mouldboard plough, disc harrow, ridger
Maintenance schedules, routine servicing, and safety protocols for tractor operators
objectives: Differentiate disc plough from mouldboard plough operations in hard tropical soils
Explain functions of the power take-off (PTO) shaft and 3-point hydraulic linkage
Calculate field capacity and operating efficiency of a mechanized tractor team

topics.topic: Agricultural Marketing Channels and Commodity Pricing
subtopics: Marketing functions: Assembling, grading, processing, transportation, storage, financing
Marketing channels: Producer -> Wholesaler -> Retailer -> Consumer
Role of Commodity Boards, cooperative societies, and export promotion in farm price stabilization
objectives: Map the commercial distribution channel of Nigerian yam and palm oil
Calculate marketing margin and producer's share of retail price in Naira
Analyze problems of agricultural marketing in Nigeria (spoilage, middlemen, bad rural roads)

topics.topic: Agricultural Extension Services and Farmer Education
subtopics: Meaning and objectives of agricultural extension
Extension teaching methods: Individual (farm visits), group (demonstrations), mass media (radio, SMS)
Agricultural Development Programmes (ADP) and village extension agent (VEA) operational challenges
objectives: Explain the role of method and result demonstrations in introducing new crop varieties
Design a farmer education campaign on avian influenza using vernacular radio and SMS
Evaluate institutional bottlenecks hindering effective agricultural extension delivery in Nigeria
